title: Pin repository snapshot and build source/document inventory
acceptance: Record exact default-branch commit; enumerate source, docs, deploy, mobile and data-definition areas; identify source-of-truth files and stale/duplicate surfaces; produce a reproducible audit entry map.
notes: Read-only external repository inspection; do not modify inventory.

title: Build current open-source inventory/ERP/WMS/electronics systems landscape
acceptance: Identify at least 12 actively maintained open-source candidates across ERP, WMS, electronics parts/BOM and commerce; capture license, activity, architecture, strongest use cases and relevance; cite current evidence.
notes: Research must use current sources at execution time.

title: Create current capability and workflow matrix
acceptance: Map all implemented capabilities by actor, trigger, data object, state transition, API, UI and audit trail; distinguish implemented, partial, placeholder and documented-only functions.

title: Audit database schema, entities, relationships and lifecycle states
acceptance: Produce ER-style entity inventory and lifecycle state map; identify integrity constraints, missing keys, duplicate concepts, migration risks, concurrency assumptions and SQLite/PostgreSQL drift.

title: Audit API surface, authentication, authorization and warehouse data scope
acceptance: Inventory endpoints and required permissions; verify server-side enforcement, object-level warehouse scope, privilege escalation paths, error semantics and missing policy checks; provide evidence references.

title: Map PC, mobile and offline user journeys and interaction debt
acceptance: Map navigation, primary workflows, duplicated screens, inconsistent controls, mobile gaps, offline gaps and friction points for warehouse, procurement, sales and admin users.

title: Audit source architecture, module boundaries and maintainability hotspots
acceptance: Assess cohesion, coupling, oversized modules, transaction boundaries, error handling, domain separation, adapters, job isolation and refactoring seams; rank maintainability risks.

title: Check documentation-to-code truth alignment
acceptance: Compare documented features, workflows, deployment claims and status with current source; list stale, ambiguous or contradictory statements and the authoritative code location.

title: Audit inventory quantity model and stock semantics
acceptance: Evaluate on-hand, available, reserved, allocated, in-transit, damaged, quarantine, sample, engineering and virtual stock concepts; identify where current single-balance semantics can cause operational errors.

title: Audit multi-warehouse, bin, shelf and physical inventory capabilities
acceptance: Assess warehouse hierarchy, bin capacity, putaway, picking, cycle count, stocktake, move, merge, barcode/QR and location accuracy; define gaps and upgrade path.

title: Audit supplier, purchase order and receiving workflow
inputs: ProcurementService;supplier and purchase tables;UI purchase pages
acceptance: Trace requisition-to-PO-to-receipt-to-return lifecycle; assess approvals, partial receipts, over/under receipt, lead time, MOQ, price breaks, supplier performance and purchase history.

title: Audit order allocation, picking, shipping and completion workflow
acceptance: Assess order confirmation, allocation, split shipment, backorder, stock shortage, cancellation, address/logistics validation, picking/packing and completion consistency.

title: Audit inter-warehouse transfer and in-transit control
acceptance: Evaluate draft/outbound/in-transit/receive/difference/exception flows; test ownership, partial receipt, merge behavior, rollback and stock ledger integrity.

title: Audit product master data, aliases, categories, units and lifecycle
acceptance: Assess SKU/part identity, naming, aliases, attributes, units, category governance, lifecycle status, duplicate prevention, merge/split rules and master-data ownership.

title: Audit BOM, bundle and product cost capabilities
acceptance: Assess BOM depth, quantity/unit, versioning, substitutes, roll-up cost, labor/process cost, bundle/kit semantics and whether current structure can support manufactured assemblies.

title: Audit pricing, channel price and margin management
acceptance: Assess list price, channel price, customer price, revisions, deal price, cost basis, gross margin, fees, promotions, price approval and history.

title: Audit import, export, backup and restore safety
acceptance: Evaluate preflight, idempotency, duplicate handling, rollback, validation, export completeness, backup retention, restore checks and disaster-recovery usability.

title: Audit OCR/AI recognition pipeline and human confirmation controls
acceptance: Assess provider abstraction, queue isolation, timeout/retry, confidence handling, duplicate screenshots, human confirmation, traceability, failure recovery and measurable recognition quality.

title: Audit marketplace/platform account and SKU mapping integration
acceptance: Assess account isolation, credential storage, SKU mapping, sync idempotency, reconciliation, rate limits, manual fallback, multi-platform extensibility and order-source traceability.

title: Audit dashboard, alerts and decision-support metrics
acceptance: Assess whether current dashboards drive actions; identify missing inventory turns, aging, stockout risk, purchase due, fulfillment SLA, dead stock, cash tied up, margin and exception KPIs.

title: Audit exception handling and operation log completeness
acceptance: Evaluate exception taxonomy, owner, SLA, reopen/close, root cause, escalation and whether every critical mutation has sufficient who/what/when/before-after evidence.

title: Assess electronics component parametric master-data fitness
inputs: materials;aliases;categories;profile fields;docs/OpenPnP物料搜索匹配移植说明.md
acceptance: Evaluate MPN, manufacturer, package, footprint, value, tolerance, voltage/current/frequency, lifecycle, RoHS, datasheet, supplier SKU and searchable parametric attributes; propose schema.

title: Assess AVL, alternate parts and substitute management
acceptance: Design gap analysis for approved vendors/manufacturers, preferred alternates, conditional substitutes, engineering approval, risk, lead time and shortage substitution traceability.

title: Assess part revision, BOM revision and ECN/ECO change control
acceptance: Determine whether current model can preserve released revisions and effective dates; define ECN/ECO approval, impact analysis, supersession and traceability requirements.

title: Assess engineering BOM to manufacturing BOM flow
acceptance: Evaluate support for engineering structure vs manufacturing structure, phantom/kit items, reference designators, loss factors, packaging, process consumables and conversion governance.

title: Assess prototype, sample and engineering-stock workflows
acceptance: Define gaps for project-owned stock, engineering issue/return, sample gifting, lab stock, non-saleable stock, prototype build consumption and accountability.

title: Assess MRP, shortage explosion and replenishment planning
acceptance: Determine requirements for gross/net demand, allocations, open POs, lead times, MOQ, safety stock, yield, due dates, multi-level BOM explosion and purchase/work-order suggestions.

title: Assess production work orders, kitting, issue/return and completion
acceptance: Gap-analyze work-order status, material reservation, kitting, issue, overissue, return, scrap, finished-goods receipt, partial completion and cancellation.

title: Assess lot, serial number and end-to-end traceability
acceptance: Assess missing lot/serial genealogy from supplier receipt through build/test to shipment and RMA; define minimum traceability model for electronics modules.

title: Assess incoming, in-process and final quality workflows
acceptance: Define gaps for IQC/IPQC/FQC/OQC, sampling, inspection records, quarantine, NCR, MRB, rework, scrap, supplier corrective action and release-to-stock.

title: Assess product test data, calibration and equipment traceability
acceptance: Assess linking serial/lot to RF/electrical test results, test reports, firmware version, operator, equipment, calibration status and pass/fail limits.

title: Assess drawings, datasheets, firmware and controlled-document linkage
acceptance: Evaluate controlled links/files, revision, approval, effective version, superseded files, checksum and access control for schematics, PCB, datasheets, firmware and test procedures.

title: Assess outsourced processing and consigned-material workflows
acceptance: Define gaps for material sent to subcontractor, outside processing PO, WIP ownership, returned quantity, scrap, processing cost and supplier accountability.

title: Assess actual manufacturing cost and variance accounting
acceptance: Assess standard vs actual material, labor, overhead, yield/scrap, freight and subcontract cost; define variance and product profitability requirements.

title: Assess omnichannel order, inventory and SKU synchronization
acceptance: Evaluate multi-shop/multi-platform order ingestion, dedupe, channel inventory publication, cancellations, refunds, shipping status sync and reconciliation.

title: Assess inquiry, quotation, sample and customer-specific sales workflow
acceptance: Identify gaps for leads/inquiries, quotations, revisions, samples, customer price tiers, validity, sales owner, conversion and follow-up history.

title: Assess demand forecast and intelligent replenishment
acceptance: Define requirements for sales velocity, seasonality, lead-time demand, service level, safety-stock tuning, slow movers, suggested reorder and forecast accuracy.

title: Assess returns, refund, RMA, repair and warranty lifecycle
acceptance: Gap-analyze return authorization, reason codes, inspection, restock/quarantine/scrap, refund/exchange, repair, warranty eligibility, serial history and closure.

title: Assess customer-service tickets and operational exception collaboration
acceptance: Assess ticket/case ownership, SLA, conversation linkage, order context, escalation, templates, root cause, recurring issue analytics and knowledge-base opportunities.

title: Assess channel settlement, fees, shipping cost, tax and contribution margin
acceptance: Identify missing marketplace fees, payment fees, coupons, freight, returns, tax, settlement reconciliation and true order/product contribution margin.

title: Assess product portfolio and commercial intelligence model
acceptance: Define a product scorecard combining sales, margin, inventory turns, stockout, aging, inquiry/conversion, repurchase, supplier risk, complexity and lifecycle; separate measured vs inferred metrics.

title: Assess owner/manager reporting and operational cockpit
acceptance: Define daily/weekly/monthly management views with exceptions first, trend/drilldown, cash tied in stock, fulfillment, purchase, production and profitability KPIs.

title: Assess scalability, concurrency and SQLite-to-PostgreSQL evolution
acceptance: Assess thread/process model, transactions, locks, job queues, pagination, caching, large tables, DB portability, migration strategy and multi-user growth bottlenecks.

title: Perform security and secrets review
acceptance: Review password/session/token design, default credentials, CSRF/CORS, injection/file upload/path traversal, credential encryption, least privilege, audit tamper resistance, backup exposure and deployment hardening.

title: Assess reliability, backup, restore, recovery and business continuity
acceptance: Define failure modes, RPO/RTO targets, restore drills, DB corruption handling, job replay, idempotency, service restart behavior, monitoring and degraded-mode operations.

title: Audit automated tests, migrations, logging and observability
acceptance: Map current test coverage and missing contract/state-transition/migration/security/load tests; define structured logs, metrics, traces, alerts and release gates.

title: Perform detailed desktop UX and information-architecture review
acceptance: Evaluate navigation depth, naming, search/filter, bulk actions, keyboard flow, error prevention, empty states, density, consistency, role-tailored home pages and high-frequency task efficiency.

title: Assess mobile, PWA, offline and synchronization experience
acceptance: Assess task suitability on phones, scanning/camera flows, offline data ownership, sync package semantics, conflict resolution, stale data, security and reconnect UX.

title: Assess global search, barcode/QR and fast warehouse interaction
acceptance: Define cross-entity search, fuzzy/alias/MPN lookup, barcode/QR labels, scan-to-receive/pick/transfer/count, duplicate prevention and handheld workflow improvements.

title: Design rules engine and event-driven automation opportunities
acceptance: Identify at least 30 safe automations with trigger, condition, action, approval, rollback and audit needs across replenishment, allocation, alerts, classification, follow-up, data quality and exception routing.

title: Design AI copilot and agent automation opportunities
acceptance: Identify assistive AI use cases for document extraction, SKU matching, anomaly detection, purchase suggestions, natural-language query, report drafting and support; specify human approval and evidence boundaries.

title: Deep benchmark open-source ERP suites
acceptance: Compare inventory, purchasing, manufacturing, BOM/MRP, sales, accounting boundaries, workflow engine, extensions, API, UX, deployment and upgrade model; cite current versions and licenses.

title: Deep benchmark electronics parts/BOM systems
acceptance: Compare parametric parts, MPN/supplier links, BOM revisions, alternates, stock locations, build orders, traceability, labels, API/plugins and electronics-specific workflows.

title: Deep benchmark open-source WMS and warehouse systems
inputs: current web sources;OpenBoxes;other maintained WMS candidates
acceptance: Compare receiving, putaway, bins, picking, replenishment, stocktake, lot/serial, transfer, mobile scanning, wave/batch operations and warehouse analytics.

title: Deep benchmark open-source commerce/order systems
inputs: current web sources;Saleor;Medusa;other maintained headless commerce candidates
acceptance: Compare product/channel/order/price/promotion/customer/return integration patterns and determine which ideas should be borrowed rather than rebuilt.

title: Extract reusable architecture and extension patterns from open-source peers
inputs: peer source repositories and architecture docs
acceptance: Extract plugin, domain module, workflow/state machine, event/job, permission, reporting, migration, API and customization patterns relevant to Inventory Lite; separate portable ideas from over-engineering.

title: Build weighted current-system vs target-needs vs open-source gap matrix
acceptance: Score at least 12 dimensions on evidence; classify Must/Should/Could/Later; show capability maturity, business impact, implementation difficulty, dependency, risk and reference systems; avoid false precision.

title: Create prioritized UX and automation improvement backlog
inputs: UX, mobile, scan, rules, AI and KPI outputs
acceptance: Produce at least 50 concrete improvements; for each include user, pain point, proposed change, expected benefit, complexity, risk, prerequisite and acceptance signal.

title: Design target architecture options for next-stage evolution
acceptance: Provide minimum-change, modular-monolith and larger-scale options; define domain boundaries, DB strategy, jobs/events, adapters, APIs, permissions, migration sequence and when each option becomes justified.

title: Build 0-3-6-12-24 month product and technical roadmap
acceptance: Sequence quick wins, foundations, manufacturing capabilities, integrations, analytics and AI; specify dependencies, migration gates, measurable outcomes and stop/go criteria; avoid big-bang rewrite.

title: Convert recommendations into implementation-ready epics and stories
acceptance: Create implementation epics with stories, data changes, API/UI touchpoints, migration, test requirements, rollout strategy and acceptance criteria; flag items needing operator decisions.

title: Produce final deep audit and strategic recommendation report
acceptance: Deliver executive summary, current-state scorecard, evidence-based findings, business-fit verdict for e-commerce electronics R&D/manufacturing/sales, open-source benchmark, top risks, top 20 recommendations, roadmap and future vision; distinguish facts, inferences and proposals.
